name: GitHub digest
description: Every morning: new issues and pull requests on the public repositories you follow, the ones waiting for your review, and failed checks.
author: The Sara team

settings.label: Repositories
settings.tip: Public repositories to follow, as owner/name separated by commas, for example nodejs/node, farena-ai/sara. At most 10.

settings.label: Your GitHub name
settings.tip: Your GitHub user name, to find pull requests waiting for your review. Leave it empty to skip that part.
